segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive or rosacea-prone skin mostly report soothing, non-irritating results with no breakouts, though one reviewer with very sensitive skin reports burning, itching and welts after five minutes of use.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including dry patches and eyelid dryness, report increased hydration and softness, with the effect described as long-lasting rather than immediate.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination (including combo/oily) skin report an even, brightened complexion, disappearance of dry patches, and smoother foundation application.
segments.oily: The one reviewer identifying combo/oily skin reports the mask cleared dry patches and evened out her glow after a single use.
segments.mature: Reviewers describing themselves as aging or in their 40s–60s report brighter, smoother, more supple skin and softened fine lines with continued use.
segments.normal: No reviews specifically describe normal skin.

concerns.aging: Reviewers with aging skin report smoother, more supple skin, softened fine lines and a long-term rather than instant effect on wrinkles.
concerns.dehydration: Many reviewers report a strong hydrating effect, with skin feeling plumped and less tight or dull; one reviewer noted no significant change in dullness or tightness.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with rosacea-prone skin reports the mask calms visible redness within 10-30 minutes; another with sensitive skin reports a burning reaction with welts instead.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers describe the mask as non-drying and gentle even alongside actives like tretinoin or azelaic acid, supporting rather than stressing the skin barrier.
concerns.spots: Several reviewers report dark spots or dullness looking lighter and skin tone more even after use; results are described as visible but gradual.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers report active breakouts, cystic pimples or adult acne clearing up or reducing overnight; one reviewer specifically doubts the mask caused her cyst's improvement, and one reviewer wanted an acne mask but found it more of a rinse-off moisturizer with no such effect.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily or combination skin report reduced shine and tightened-looking pores after use, though one notes she has only medium pores and is unsure of results on larger ones.

extraits.texte: I followed the directions but as soon as I done applying the mask, my skin began to burn and itch. I only used it for about 5 mins. When I wiped it off, my face had welts. I typically get these after an eyebrow wax-so if you experience that too, stay away. On the bright side, my skin does seem rejuvenated. Like a chemical peel lol.

I use this mask weekly. I find it to be gentle and effective - it is not harsh or overly drying, even on my super sensitive, rosacea prone skin. If you are looking for a quick result for things like dark spots, this is not the mask to use. It is a more long term result after multiple uses kind of thing. I use tret 2-3x weekly and azaleic acid daily and this has never been an issue when I use this mask weekly. However, I do not use tret on the night prior or the same day that I do this mask just to be careful.

extraits.titre: You'll get a lot of use out it
extraits.texte: I have sensitive and dry skin to the point where i get dry patches on my eyelids and a lot of products even facial lotion irritates me. I bought this after i had gotten a sample and it soothe my skin. I only use it when i feel my skin acting up. I lay it on thick, let it dry, wash it off and follow it with my usual skin care (a serum and moisturizer.) definitely worth it, it lasts me months

I have a hard time finding skin care that doesnt irritate my skin. I have incredibly sensitive, oily, hive and acne prone skin so my main goal with any skin care product is to soothe. This is shockingly soothing and the only face mask ive ever used that I can immediately see an improvement. If my face is showing irritation and redness, I will use this for 10-30 minutes and when I remove it, the redness is completely gone. I will always keep this on hand. The only down side is the price.

extraits.titre: Cyst pimple went down over night
extraits.texte: I got this as my birthday gift from ulta. I just used it to see how I'd do it was like a thick lotion consistency so i just expected moisture not expecting it to clear up this giant pimple I got out of no where. I woke up the next morning and my pimple was completely gone. I don't think this is an acne treatment or if this is necessarily the reason it cleared up? But it was the only thing I used differently. So 10/10 and my face does feel very moisturized as well.

extraits.titre: Masque makes your skin feel like new
extraits.texte: This can be expensive, but it is absolutely worth it. I use this masque about once a month, and it totally resurfaces my face, keeping it smooth and hydrated for weeks. You don't need to use a ton of product either—it is very effective even with just an even thin layer all over. I am almost 40 and my skin feels better now than when I was in my 20s.
I ordered this thinking that it would be more of a mask to help with my acne self care routine but instead it's like a hydrating moisturizer that you rinse off. Will try it a few more times
